title: The Bosphorus Brief — 6 August 2026
overview: Parliament takes up the "Terrorism-Free Turkey" bill just as a large citizenship-revocation drive and a Kurdish amnesty debate both move forward — a busy day for legal-status news. Regionally, Lebanon saw fresh strikes and Ceuta's migrant surge continues to dominate European coverage. The lira held steady against the dollar and euro.
heading: Terror-Free Turkey Bill Heads to Parliament
body: USD/TRY sits at 47.56 and EUR/TRY at 54.81, little changed. Analysts continue to flag pressure on the lira from July inflation data and FX rules (Commerzbank via CryptoRank). In other news, combat pilot Özlem İyidilli Karapınar has become the first woman promoted to brigadier general in Turkish Air Force history — reported by both state and opposition-leaning outlets without divergence.
closing: Stay grounded, keep your paperwork handy, and have a good Thursday.
